name: Hawaii DOE Student Summer Internships (DOE Offices and Schools)
what_you_do: Work a summer internship at a Hawaii DOE state office, a complex area office, or a school. Each internship has its own duties and hours.
who_can_apply: Students who are at least 16. Summer 2026 was for high school sophomores (Class of 2028), juniors (Class of 2027), or students in a Community School for Adults. A program of study that fits the internship is preferred.
pay_detail: Pay is not stated on the program page.
duration: Dates and hours vary by internship. Summer 2026 ran June to July.
deadline_text: Summer 2026 applications opened Mar 30, 2026 and closed Apr 10, 2026. Summer 2027 dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: Download the Student Intern Casual Employment Application and fill it out. Email it to the contact for the internship you want, or drop off a paper copy. High school internships are only for students at that school.
notes: The positions list is a separate sheet linked from the program page.
